Care@Work - who is caring for the unpaid carers in the workforce

Different Journeys are leaders in helping unpaid carers manage the impacts of caring on their working lives, find out about supports available to them, and access these free resources. We support carers and employers to understand each other’s needs. We improve carer wellbeing to reduce the risk of employers losing valuable staff.

Over the last eight years, Different Journeys has provided peer support to over 10,000 carers and people with autism. Together, we have exchanged isolation for connection and hope. Our focus on carers has continued to grow; today, this is the larger part of our work.

We acknowledge carers’ many unpaid responsibilities and their critical contribution to our community. We walk alongside carers to enable them to access services and resources and help them negotiate the many barriers that can be placed in their way.

We also create systems and environments that acknowledge, support, and protect carers at every stage of their journey in our workplace. We do this because it allows us to attract and retain team members with remarkable talents and because we want to show what is possible.

Fruit2Work is a social enterprise that provides employment and support to people with lived experience in the justice system through the delivery of fresh fruit, milk and workplace snacks.

Fruit2Work is a certified not-for-profit social enterprise and registered charity on a mission to create meaningful employment opportunities for people impacted by the justice system—helping them rebuild confidence, reconnect with family, and reintegrate into society.
We deliver high‑quality, locally sourced fruit, milk, pantry items, and vending services to workplaces across Melbourne, Geelong, Ballarat, Brisbane, Gold Coast, and Sunshine Coast, via agile operations across multi‑site, multi‑floor premises.

All produce are Australian suppliers with ethical practices and modern‑slavery policies, alongside packaging recycling to support circular economy goals.

Our impact has generated over 240 employment opportunities (transitioning more than 200 people), achieving a world-leading zero recidivism rate—compared to ~50% average in Australia—and avoiding an estimated $35–500 million+ in social and re‑incarceration costs.
In summary, Fruit2Work blends exceptional workplace delivery services with a powerful social mission—creating work, rebuilding lives, and generating strong community value through purpose‑driven trade.

locations.description:
WYN Hub is a social enterprise and ethical business hub in Melbourne's West, building the ecosystem and moving the dial towards a place-based wellbeing economy.

WYN Hub exists to transform the role business plays in our society, from an extractive, profit-at-all-costs model to one rooted in cultural expression, community care, and systems change. We believe that businesses can be agents of justice, inclusion, and sustainability when given the support and imagination to operate differently.

We approach systems change through two mutually reinforcing lenses:
1. Consumer Power and 2. Business Capability.

Over the next 2-5 years, we are focused on foundational shifts including:
- Raised Awareness – People understand what social enterprise is and why values-aligned business matters.
- Cultural Reframing – Business norms are challenged. We create space for diverse cultural ways of doing business, especially non-Western and community-based traditions.
- Connection & Community – Entrepreneurs and values-driven consumers find each other, forming networks of shared learning and action.
- Access to Resources – People can find tools, templates, coaching, and accessible business education tailored to purpose-driven goals.
- Inspiration & Visibility – Stories of ethical, community-driven businesses are elevated and celebrated.
